from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
for case in sorted(Path('.').glob('*/observer.json')):
    observation = json.loads(case.read_text())
    output = observation['requested_output']
    artifact = case.parent / ('answer.md' if output == 'chat response' else f'after/{output}')

/bin/bash -lc "python -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
for task in sorted(Path('.').glob('*/task.md')):
    root = task.parent
    before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in (root / 'before/materials').iterdir()}
    after = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in (root / 'after/materials').iterdir()}
    observer = json.loads((root / 'observer.json').read_text())
    actions = json.loads((root / 'actions.json').read_text())
    target = observer['requested_output']
    artifact = root / ('answer.md' if target == 'chat response' else 'after/' + target)
    content = artifact.read_bytes()
    view = observer['assessor_packet_view']
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    print(root, 'sources_unchanged', before == after,
          'changes', actions['changed'], observer['all_project_paths_changed'],
          'view_match', (len(content), digest) == (view['bytes'], view['sha256']),
          'original_match', (len(content), digest) == (observer['readback_bytes'], observer['readback_sha256']),
          'recorded_normalization', not view['equal_to_original'])
PY"
